design_description: A vibrant, lake-inspired football kit for Chapala, featuring a striking royal blue base with layered shades of blue and white. Dynamic diagonal brushstrokes sweep across the lower torso, transitioning into a detailed landscape of mountains, shimmering lake waters, and a sailing boat, celebrating the region's natural beauty. A clean upper chest showcases the club crest and subtle Momuto branding, while navy-and-white collar and sleeve trims provide a refined finish. The back continues the panoramic scenery beneath bold white player names and numbers, with a dedicated memorial inscription near the hem. Matching navy shorts with royal blue accents complete an elegant, meaningful design that combines local identity, sporting tradition, and tribute.
